criteria.description: POST /agent-sessions/:id/shell { command } invokes client.session.shell with the command + a resolved model (vitest spy, real model shape) and returns { messageId }; empty command → 400; SDK error → AppError 502 (never silent).
The mounted Terminal tab shows a command input; pressing Enter dispatches runShellCommand and clears the input.
A terminal command's output renders in the Terminal tab via TerminalOutputView — real-surface widget test on the mounted SessionSidePanel.
Terminal-originated messages are excluded from the main chat transcript.
No-authed-model / SDK error surfaces as an inline error line in the tab, not a silent no-op.
ai-workflow checks --level pr exit 0; vitest + flutter test green.
